title: Evaluate harness effectiveness
status_detail: proposed inactive; separate explicit human activation required and no automatic successor activation
objective: Join operational telemetry with Task contracts, Git changes, validation observations, review findings, and human decisions while distinguishing observations from evaluations.
authorized_scope: Treat repeated tool calls, duplicate dispatch, and control-file changes as observations; judge necessity, harm, or disproportionate ceremony only as Task-class-dependent evaluations supported by repository evidence.
Keep software verification, scientific validation, human acceptance, and general superiority claims outside conclusions established by operational efficiency alone.
completion_criteria: Evaluation outputs identify their repository evidence, distinguish observation from judgment, and state missing or noncomparable evidence explicitly.
exclusions: The Task remains inactive, requires separate explicit human activation, performs no work merely by existing, and activates no successor automatically.

This layout does not authorize telemetry implementation, public telemetry interfaces, Pi extensions, session parsing, arbitrary historical-session discovery, SQLite creation, live instrumentation, runtime hooks, benchmarks, dashboards, remote export, external data transmission, sensitive payload retention, scientific work, dependency changes, lockfile changes, or changes to Pi.
